# Brand Ideation

Curated by Skill Harbor — the divergent-then-convergent phase of brand creation, before any identity work: it generates positioning territories, naming candidates, mood directions, and narrative angles, then helps you narrow many half-formed ideas down to one committed direction with explicit trade-offs. It works upstream of logo and style-guide work and can stress-test an existing brand idea before you invest in identity. Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @rampstackco. Honest caveats: a thinking discipline, no code and no assets — it produces directions and words, not designs; naming candidates still need your own trademark and domain checks; convergence quality depends on the inputs you give it (category, audience, why the brand exists). Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
